scholarships.title: Merit Scholarship Program for Foreign Students (PBEEE) - Fonds de recherche du Quebec
scholarships.official_source: Fonds de recherche du Quebec (FRQ) - secteur Nature et technologies, commissioned by the Ministere de l'Enseignement superieur du Quebec

existing.description: In support of the Quebec government's science policy, the Merit Scholarship for Foreign Students (PBEEE) supports the internationalization of research activities in Quebec higher education institutions, attracts top foreign researchers and students, and creates cultural links for joint research projects. It is managed by the Fonds de recherche du Quebec - secteur Nature et technologies, which was commissioned by the Ministere de l'Enseignement superieur du Quebec, which provides the funding. The programme has four component types - master's research, doctoral research, postdoctoral and short-term research or professional development - available both to students of all countries and, through five bilateral components, to students from Brazil, China, India, Israel and Wallonia. Recipients must be preselected by a Quebec university or the CCTT network, and scholarship payments begin only after FRQ receives a copy of the study permit (doctoral) or work permit (postdoctoral).
eligibility: Not a Canadian citizen or permanent resident of Canada, and not having applied for permanent residence under Canadian immigration laws
Preselected by a Quebec university or the CCTT network as of October 23, 2025 (or by the China Scholarship Council as of March 31, 2026 for the Quebec-China component)

Master's research component: the master's programme must lead to the writing of a thesis - essays, research reports, dissertations and papers are not accepted, and professional master's programmes are not eligible; candidates must have been enrolled for up to three full-time semesters (1 year) or less before May 1, 2026
Doctoral research component: eligible for the first nine semesters of doctoral study, with all prior doctoral semesters subtracted

Postdoctoral component: PhD obtained no more than two years before the competition deadline, or doctoral dissertation submitted by January 15, 2026; research must be in an institution other than the one that granted the doctorate, and prior doctoral supervisors may not act as postdoctoral supervisor

Short-term component: technical and university students (option A) or researchers who completed a doctorate no more than five years before the deadline (option B); research must be in an institution other than the one at which the student was enrolled when they applied
Must not have already received a Merit Scholarship for Foreign Students from the MES
Quebec-Wallonia candidates must have previously studied in a French-language university-level institution in Belgium
Recipients must be physically present in Quebec for the entire funding period and attend the institution at which they were preselected; joint (cotutelle) degree programmes are not eligible
existing.eligibility_summary: These scholarships are intended for foreign students or researchers from all research sectors (health, humanities and social sciences, arts and letters, natural sciences, and engineering) preselected by a Quebec university or the CCTT network, or by the China Scholarship Council for the Quebec-China component, who wish to begin or continue studies or research activities in Quebec. The competition is open to all candidates who are not Canadian citizens or permanent residents of Canada and who have not applied for permanent residence under Canadian immigration laws. Candidates must be preselected to take part, and must not have already received a Merit Scholarship for Foreign Students from the MES.
benefits: Exemption from the higher tuition fees charged to foreign students in Quebec
Exemption from RAMQ medical insurance coverage costs
Access to all-countries components and to five country-specific components (Quebec-Brazil, Quebec-China, Quebec-India, Quebec-Israel, Quebec-Wallonia) arising from agreements with foreign governments
coverage: Master's research scholarship (VM): $20,000 per year, maximum $40,000 over 6 instalments
Doctoral research scholarship (V1, 1B, 1C, 1I, 1IS, 1W): $25,000 per year for the first 9 sessions, $12,000 for the last 3 sessions if an extension is requested, maximum $87,000 over 12 sessions
Short-term research or professional development scholarship (V3, 3B, 3C, 3I, 3IS, 3W): $3,000 per month, maximum 4 instalments (4 months) totalling $12,000
In addition to the scholarship, MES offers all recipients an exemption from paying the higher tuition fees required for foreign students and the medical insurance coverage offered by the RAMQ
requirements: Be preselected by a Quebec university, the CCTT network or the China Scholarship Council before the FRQ deadline
Create an account in the FRQnet system and complete the electronic form FRQ contacts you for
Attach all required documents, which cannot be updated after the application deadline
Submit electronically by the competition deadline; an application submitted after the deadline is deemed inadmissible
Notifies FRQ of acceptance or refusal of a funding offer no later than 30 days after notification via the FRQnet portal
documents: it is recommended to validate the eligibility of the exception with the program manager before submitting the application form

existing.english_requirement: Not stated as a formal requirement. The official page states that 'Documents submitted in a language other than French or English must be accompanied by a basic translation', so French or English is the working language of the application.
application_method: Institutions submit nominations of preselected candidates through the FRQnet system, transmitted electronically by 4 p.m. on the institution's deadline
Preselected candidates create an FRQnet account, are contacted by FRQ and complete an electronic form with the required documents attached
For the postdoctoral and short-term components, the supervisor submits a letter of acceptance directly through the FRQnet portal
existing.selection_notes: Two-stage process: university/CCTT preselection, then FRQ evaluation by multidisciplinary committees based on academic excellence and research potential.
existing.best_fit: Outstanding international graduate students and researchers pursuing studies at Quebec universities.
existing.notes: Funding period: per year for master's and doctoral components; per month for the short-term component
existing.duration: Master's: maximum 6 instalments (6 semesters). Doctoral: maximum 12 sessions (12 instalments), with $25,000 for the first 9 sessions and $12,000 for the last 3 if an extension is requested. Postdoctoral: maximum 12 months, not renewable. Short-term research or professional development: 4 months, not renewable.
existing.application_period: University preselection: October 2025; FRQ final submission: December 2, 2025
existing.deadline_display: Deadline (application): December 2nd, 2025 at 16:00 (EST) for the 2026-2027 competition. University and CCTT Network preselection of applications to FRQ: October 23, 2025, 4 p.m. Candidates preselected by the China Scholarship Council: before March 31, 2026. The 2026-2027 rules are marked out of competition and no next-cycle date was published as at 2026-10-04.
